covers: Actual createSfPersonalViews composed with createSfPersonalViewAuthority, createSfProductAuthority, source persistence and SQLite driver, with the same callbacks as host-context.
Explicit human save of Planner OPEX year/version/owner/class/mode/query/period/currency/density and Procurement Suppliers year/status/supplier/query/density.
Driver is closed; a new driver and product authority reopen the same durable directory. Newly admitted human reads assert exact saved records and their list.
Removing the actual Planner version makes its saved view unavailable and removes it from the authorized list; revocation of the principal denies an already admitted open.
limitations: Authenticator and installation identity are explicit test fixtures; this is not native Session or global acceptance.
Same logical ID replacement cannot be established because the published SfPersonalView contract does not carry destination incarnation.
Awaiting hosted test-ci execution and independent reviewer recheck; no test PASS is claimed.
validation: Read-only static source/contract inspection and byte hashing only. No local product test, build, typecheck or runtime import.
